Key for Schools
Reading and Writing

                        Sample Test

Time 1 hour

INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES
Do not open this question paper until you are told to do so.
Write your name, centre number and candidate number on your answer sheet if they are
not already there.
Read the instructions for each part of the paper carefully.
Answer all the questions.
Read the instructions on the answer sheet.
Write your answers on the answer sheet. Use a pencil.
You must complete the answer sheet within the time limit.
At the end of the test, hand in both this question paper and your answer sheet.

Joe    Three teenagers describe the summer camp they went to
Mark
Kevin             This was my first summer camp and I was a bit scared about going, but I soon
                  made friends with a boy called Henry, so everything was fine. We shared a
                  tent and one night we went out into the forest and spent the night under the
                  stars! There were lots of sports activities available at the camp, but I wanted to
                  do something different and did an art project in the main hall most days. It was
                  an awesome week but there was no Wi-Fi, so I couldn’t use my tablet.

                  I’ve been to a few summer camps but this year’s was the best. We stayed in a
                  house by a lake and we sailed, swam and water-skied every day. I’ve only
                  done water-skiing a few times, so it was a bit scary. But I was still glad I did it.
                  When I got home, I went onto the camp’s website and wrote about how much I
                  loved my week there and how everyone should go at least once.

                  I always enjoy going to summer camp and this year I stayed in a fantastic, old
                  house in the mountains. I couldn’t believe the views – the place was amazing.
                  We had the internet there but I stupidly went without my phone! I was quite
                  lucky I suppose because the only time I missed it was when I wanted to tell my
                  family about the running competition I entered. We had to run twenty
                  kilometres, and I wasn’t very fit at the time, so I didn’t think I’d do well.

Part 3

Questions 14 – 18

For each question, choose the correct answer.

                    My hobby – skateboarding

             14-year-old Ellie Briggs talks about skateboarding

Skateboarding wasn’t popular where I lived when I was younger, which is
strange, because there was a good local skateboard shop. But one day, I
was walking home from school with my friends, and a boy went past us on
his skateboard. I loved the way he moved on the board, and decided to try
the sport myself.

Of course, I was very bad at skateboarding when I started, but there are
many ways to learn. My cousin says he learned from going to the skatepark and seeing what
everyone was doing, but it was the videos that skateboarders post on the internet that were most
useful for me.

Even the best skateboarders fall off their boards. And when you’re learning a new jump, you fall off
lots of times. What’s important, when it happens, is that you don’t hurt yourself. That’s something
other people can show you how to do.

I love skateboarding. My parents are happy about me doing it, too, because I spend lots of time
outdoors and take part in competitions. The best thing for me is all the friends I have at the
skatepark. I’ve met some really nice people there.

Last week, I saw a man going to work on an electric skateboard. I was interested to know more, so
I found some online reviews. People say they’re simple to ride and really useful, but I couldn’t
believe the price. They’ll have to get a lot cheaper before I get one!

Questions 19 – 24
For each question, choose the correct answer.

                                     Denali National Park

Every year, about 400,000 people visit Denali National Park in Alaska, USA. They go to walk in the
beautiful (19) …………, to ski and to climb Denali, the highest mountain in North America.
There is just one road through the park. It’s (20) ………… to drive on the first fifteen miles of it, but
to go (21) ………… into the park, you have to walk, cycle or take a bus. And if you (22) ………… to
take a bus tour, you need to book it before you get to the park.

For people who (23) ………… to spend more than one day in the park, there are lots of campsites
to (24) ………… at. However, you have to be careful, as there are lots of wild animals in the park.

19 A countryside  B view         C geography
20 A available    B possible     C able
21 A wider        B longer       C further
22 A think        B know         C decide
23 A enjoy        B want         C feel
24 A stay         B live         C be
